    I · The Bienal

    The agenda

    One question for 2027 — opportunities and threats in a post-money world — and three blocks where it is already a practical matter. The blocks run across both days: in public at the Summit, in closed session at the Forum.

    II · The product

    Two days, five rooms

    MACA holds the institutional layer: the Forum and the Summit. Casa Manantial holds the private layer: the Dinner and the Party. Three Branded Houses run alongside, one per lead partner.

    1. Friday01The ForumA central-bank fireside on the record, a closed regulatory roundtable and a capital session. No exhibition floor.MACA
      100–150
    2. Friday night02The DinnerRegulators, allocators and builders at one table. Off the record; no press.Casa Manantial
      60–80
    3. Saturday03The SummitOpening keynote and anchor panels across the three blocks.MACA
      400–600
    4. Saturday night04The PartyThe closing event of the edition.Casa Manantial
      150–200
    5. All weekend05The Branded HousesThree private villas, held by the Master and Diamond partners.Punta del Este
      3 villas

    II · The product

    Why here, why now

    01Regulation in forceLaw 20,345 sets Uruguay’s framework for virtual assets. The Central Bank supervises their providers.
    02Capital in seasonFamily offices and private capital from Argentina, Brazil, Chile and Uruguay spend the southern summer in Punta del Este.
    03Stable institutionsPredictable rules, and contracts denominated in US dollars as standard practice.
    04The namePunta del Este already carries weight in the region’s capital circles. The name pre-sells the room.
    415billion USDCrypto value received in Latin America, July 2023 – June 2024.
    42.5%Year-on-year growth over the same period.
    20,345LawUruguay’s virtual-asset law, in force.

    Sources · Chainalysis, The 2024 Geography of Cryptocurrency Report · Law 20,345, Uruguay

    III · Partnership

    Three partners, three houses

    The Master and the two Diamond partners each hold a private villa for the weekend of the Bienal.

    /01 · The houseStaffed, private, co-brandedA villa in Punta del Este from Friday to Sunday, co-branded with the partner. Held within the Master and Diamond positions; not sold separately.
    /02 · The useThe partner’s own programmeTeam base, client meetings and a side programme with the partner’s own guest list. The partner may sell access to it and keeps the content it produces.
    /03 · The scheduleFixed slotsSide programmes run on Friday after the Dinner, on Saturday evening and on Sunday. They do not overlap the Forum or the Summit.

    IV · Terms

    Terms and calendar

    Sequence
    • Positions are allocated from the top tier down.
    • The Master position is offered first. The remaining tiers open in order.
    • Unsold positions are withdrawn or repriced. They are not discounted privately.
    Calendar
    • Now. Conversations for the Master and Diamond positions.
    • Before positions open. Committee and public institutions published.
    • March 2027. First edition: two days, Punta del Este.
    • 2029. Second edition. The Master partner holds the first right of renewal.
    The agreement
    • Position, tier and benefits; allocation of passes and seats.
    • Branded House terms, where applicable.
    • Brand use, approvals and content rights; payment schedule and cancellation.
